label: Ambient yoghurt
note: Heated to 75–110 °C for 5–20 s and filled aseptically, so it keeps 4–12 months at room temperature; sold as drinking yoghurt pouches

about.text: Yoghurt heated to 75–110 °C for 5–20 s after fermenting and filled aseptically, so it keeps 4–12 months at room temperature; sold as drinking yoghurt pouches.
